This article lists all matches that the club played in the 2000–01 season, and also shows statistics of the club's players. == Summary == This was the season where the club won its 28th [[2000–01 La Liga|La Liga]] title, having begun a new policy of signing the world's greatest players under a new president, [[Florentino Pérez]], with a goal of making Real Madrid the most fashionable club in the world. [[Luís Figo]] was the arrival of the year, along with [[Claude Makélélé]], and they helped a team of stars, dubbed the ''[[galácticos]]'', win the league under [[Vicente del Bosque]], as well as reaching the [[2000–01 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]] semi-finals as defending champions, where they were narrowly knocked out by [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]]. The arrival of [[Luís Figo]] in July 2000 was controversial due to his move from [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] to Real Madrid, thus generating furious reactions from Barcelona fans and also [[Boixos Nois]] hooligans. === Overview === {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center" |- !rowspan=2|Competition !colspan=8|Record !rowspan=2|Result !rowspan=2|Top Scorer |- !{{abbr|G|Games played}} !{{abbr|W|Games won}} !{{abbr|D|Games drawn}} !{{abbr|L|Games lost}} !{{abbr|GF|Goals for}} !{{abbr|GA|Goals against}} !{{abbr|GD|Goal difference}} !{{abbr|Win %|Winning percentage}} |- | [[2000–01 La Liga|La Liga]] {{WDL|38|24|8|6|for=81|against=40|diff=yes}} | style="background:gold;"|Winners | {{flagicon|ESP}} [[Raúl (footballer)|Raúl]], 24 |- | [[2000–01 Copa del Rey|Copa del Rey]] {{WDL|1|0|0|1|for=1|against=2|diff=yes}} | Round of 64 | {{flagicon|BRA}} [[Sávio (footballer, born 1974)|Sávio]], 1 |- | [[2000–01 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]] {{WDL|16|9|2|5|for=35|against=23|diff=yes}} | Semi-finals | {{flagicon|ESP}} Raúl, 7 |- | [[2000 UEFA Super Cup|UEFA Super Cup]] {{WDL|1|0|0|1|for=1|against=2|diff=yes}} | style="background:silver;"|Runners-up | {{flagicon|ESP}} Raúl, 1 |- | [[2000 Intercontinental Cup|Intercontinental Cup]] {{WDL|1|0|0|1|for=1|against=2|diff=yes}} | style="background:silver;"|Runners-up | {{flagicon|BRA}} [[Roberto Carlos]], 1 |- !
